howToPlay: Use your health to hold space and position aggressively near teammates to maximize the benefits of your gadgets and star powers. Activate your Super to block and reflect incoming damage while using your gadgets to sustain yourself or control enemy positions. Coordinate your attacks to ensure you are dealing bonus damage while allies are nearby.
gears: Equip HEALTH to recover faster between fights and DAMAGE to increase your impact while at low health. GADGET COOLDOWN is also useful to utilize your utility more frequently during the match.
trait: This brawler suits a defensive team player who excels at protecting allies and controlling the flow of battle.
